searchText: MSRP $245,092. New 2027 Tiffin GH2 24FV Luxury Sprinter Class C RV. Features Hydronic Heating W/ Electric Appliances Lithium Batteries Induction Cooktop Showermiser 2 Solar Panels More About This RV Tiffin built its name on luxury diesel coaches and with the GH2, that same obsession with detail comes to the trailhead. The 2027 GH2 24FV is an all-terrain adventure van built on the Mercedes-Benz Sprinter chassis with all-wheel drive and powered by a 2.0L twin-scroll turbo-diesel producing 208 horsepower and 332 lb-ft of torque through a 9-speed automatic. As the longest of the three GH2 floorplans, the 24FV stretches the layout out for extra living space without giving up the go-anywhere footprint that makes a Sprinter van so easy to live with. Outside, a Girard powered patio awning with integrated LED lighting, a fold-down exterior worktop, a Rolef bug-screen door package, a welded roof-access ladder, and standard Starlink prewire mean you can set up camp and stay connected just about anywhere the map runs out. Refined where it counts and rugged where it matters, the GH2 24FV is the adventure van for travelers who want Tiffin luxury with the freedom to leave the pavement behind.
